prompts.title: Pool Splash Portrait
prompts.text:
EDIT THE UPLOADED PHOTO — DO NOT CREATE A DIFFERENT PERSON.

Use my uploaded original photo as the PRIMARY and LOCKED identity reference.

Transform the uploaded photo into a completely photorealistic swimming-pool photograph, similar in composition and overall look to the reference image.

SCENE:
Place the person naturally standing waist/chest-deep inside a real blue swimming pool. The person is wearing the same dark navy blue traditional shirt from the original photo. The shirt should look naturally wet from being in the water, with realistic wet fabric texture.

POSE:
Keep the person's body natural and realistic. Both arms should be extended forward with both hands raised slightly above the water, creating natural splashes of water from the hands, similar to the reference image.

HAIR:
Make the existing hairstyle look naturally wet, slightly messy and realistic, as if the person has just been in the swimming pool. Do NOT change the person's hairline, hair shape, or identity.

BACKGROUND:
Use a realistic outdoor swimming pool environment with clear blue water, natural reflections, realistic water ripples and splashes, and a softly blurred poolside background.

PHOTOREALISM:
Make the final image look like a real photograph taken with a high-quality camera. Natural lighting, realistic skin texture, realistic water droplets, realistic wet clothing, accurate shadows and reflections.

MOST IMPORTANT — FACE & IDENTITY LOCK:
Keep the person's face EXACTLY the same as in the uploaded original photo.
